# DocuMorph (SKYESOVERLONDON)

DocuMorph is an offline-first PWA that converts PDFs into a study dashboard:
reader, flashcards, quizzes, and analytics.

Key pages:
- / (landing)
- /app/ (app)
- /privacy
- /terms

AI engines shown to users:
- SKYESOVERLONDON • SkyesFlash (Gemini-backed)
- SKYESOVERLONDON • SkyesCrown (OpenAI-backed)

Last updated: 2026-05-10
